title: Mouse support: click tabs, rows and keys (needs ui.mouse)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owners who use the pointer want to click tabs, rows and project keys. docs/dashboard.md:12 says mouse clicks do the same as keys. Decided: record 129 (ui.mouse): off in v1; if built, opt-in by flag. Mouse capture also blocks terminal text selection, which matters for copying the slicer land command (docs/dashboard.md:102-103).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `cmd/ork/main.go:78` (tea.NewProgram; no mouse option today).
- `internal/tui/view.go:22` (v.AltScreen is set here; set the mouse mode here if chosen), view.go:97 (sidebar, project clicks), view.go:167-171 (viewBar, view tabs).
- `internal/tui/model.go` (new mouse message case beside the key dispatch).
- `internal/tui/overview.go` (row hit test for the Overview cursor).
- `internal/tui/tui_test.go` and `internal/tui/golden_test.go`; `testdata/golden/` only if a view changes.
- `docs/dashboard.md:12` and :102-103; the help view.
Decided: record 129 (ui.mouse): off by default, opt-in by flag. Capture stops terminal text selection.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestClickViewTabSwitchesView: a click on a view tab does what tab does.
- TestClickOverviewRowMovesCursor: a click on a row matches down-arrow movement to that row.
- TestClickOutsideRowsDoesNothing.
- TestClickWhileConfirmBarOpenChangesNothing: ui.confirm (decided, #98) stays in charge.
- TestMouseOffByDefault: without the opt-in flag no mouse message is handled and the terminal keeps its own selection (record 129).
- TestMouseOptInHandlesClicks: with the flag the clicks above work.
- The help view and docs/dashboard.md name the mouse behaviour.
